passages.text: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
passages.note: Worry for loved ones left behind; trust

passages.text: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.
passages.note: Feeling lost, misled, restless; forgetting where one belongs
